scope: CPU algebra check of clearance phase and instantaneous position/velocity continuity when the remaining base path is refitted. This does not execute or validate the Unreal runtime.
procedure: For each original duration and trial, advance the current local step phase by dt/local_duration.

Before each randomly selected intermediate tick, preserve global_phase = phase_start + (1-phase_start)*local_phase and remaining_duration=(1-local_phase)*local_duration, then set local_phase=0 and phase_start=global_phase.
Compare sin(pi*global_phase)^2*10.8 clearance against the unretargeted original i/ticks phase at every sample, including landing.

At each replan, subtract the current lift displacement and analytic vertical lift velocity from a synthetic outgoing position/velocity; add the preserved phase displacement and derivative back and compare the instantaneous boundary.
Assert all final phases reach 1 and maximum errors remain below 1e-10.
not_tested: Engine compilation, launch, skinning, or rendering
Actual foot lift, landing, skating, or visual pelvis continuity
Horizontal target reach and collision/terrain tracing
Speed-changing or stopping phase-rate derivatives and active velocity clamps
Full AI path or combat regression
required_game_validation: Full 32s Shipping Melee and Caster recordings, including Melee 300-480 and former drag 442-449; inspect actual images and world trajectories together.
